description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueXNormalizable' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. The interface declares a method 'toArrayXValue' intended for normalizing or converting an attribute 'x' of a 'SelectedFilterField' entity to an array. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically related to report filtering functionality.

classes.name: ValueXNormalizable
classes.description: Interface for entities that can normalize the 'x' value of a selected filter field to an array.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the 'x' value of a SelectedFilterField to an array, possibly for normalization or serialization.
